info.title: Piloti workspace API
info.description: Piloti is the workspace for architects: a planning office runs its projects, documents and processes in it, and Piloti, the agent, works in that office as a colleague. This document describes what an agent or a script can do there, acting as a signed-in person: every operation is a route the Piloti app itself calls, under the same permissions. These paths accept the app’s signed-in session; an agent calls every operation as an MCP tool at /api/mcp, by the same name as its operationId, with an OAuth token.

200.description: Success. The body is the route’s JSON answer; no response schema is declared for it yet, so read the operation description for what it contains.

sessionCookie.name: wos-session
sessionCookie.description: The Piloti app’s signed-in session (WorkOS AuthKit), as a browser holds it. A bearer token is not accepted here: an agent holds an OAuth token for the MCP server at /api/mcp and calls the operations there.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The error body every route answers with (`errorResponse` in lib/api/handler.ts). The same request id is sent in the `x-request-id` header.

code.description: A machine-readable code such as BAD_REQUEST, FORBIDDEN or NOT_FOUND.

details.description: Optional machine-readable details; the shape depends on the code.

requestId.description: The request id, for support and log correlation.

Error400.description: The input failed the route’s own validation (bad JSON, schema violation, invalid parameter).

Error403.description: Signed in, but the person may not do this here.

Error404.description: The resource does not exist, or the person may not see it.

Error429.description: Rate limited. Wait for the `Retry-After` header before calling again.
